reason: They don't name the payment company, the per-transaction fee or when the money lands in my account, and that's the first thing I need to know. I already pay a fee on my card terminal, so I won't move guests to a second payment route until I see those numbers, free months or not.
objection: Who is the payment partner, what percent do they take on top of the 59 lari, and how many days until I get paid? If it's more than my terminal or slower, it's eating my margin on every bill.
would_change_my_mind: A named Georgian bank as the partner, a per-transaction fee no higher than my current terminal, and next-day payout in writing, plus proof tourists actually leave reviews that bring in new guests.
